name: Katagiri Mayuu
source:
Zodiac: Aries
Precise weight: 42.5 kg.

Mayuu's parents are world-renowned celebrities, her father is a director, her mother is an actress, perhaps this is why she is so graceful, disciplined, and can be rarely seen upset. However, that is a mask she wears for her parents and for the media, her original personality is bright and mischievous. Mayuu also tried her hand in acting, but she has not performed on stage after her leg was injured during a recording of a TV show she starred in when she was 14. Since then she just tries to live a normal school life.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031014071144/http://www.pinkpineapple.co.jp/pinpai/xmas/character/character.html]official website[/url].]
